name: Compounding OpenDollar
oneLiner: cUSDO is OpenEden's non-rebasing wrapper of USDO that compounds T-Bill yield through price appreciation rather than balance changes.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: cUSDO resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

collateral: USDO wrapped into OpenEden's non-rebasing cUSDO format; the wrapper holds USDO, which is backed by tokenized U.S. Treasury Bills (primarily OpenEden TBILL and BlackRock BUIDL tokens) held by OpenEden Digital (OED) at 100% collateralization; cUSDO yield accrues through price appreciation rather than rebasing
pegMechanism: Users can wrap USDO into cUSDO or unwrap cUSDO back into USDO at any time; unlike rebasing USDO, cUSDO compounds by increasing in redeemable USDO per token

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: cUSDO is a wrapped form of USDO and inherits USDO's Chainlink CCIP cross-chain route. The route uses CCIP token-transfer infrastructure and external oracle-network validation rather than a canonical rollup bridge or issuer-only burn/mint rail.

protocols.name: Chainlink CCIP
protocols.note: OpenEden announced USDO interoperability through Chainlink CCIP; cUSDO is the wrapper of USDO.

mintAuthority.summary: cUSDO is OpenEden's non-rebasing savings-passthrough wrapper of USDO; shares are minted when USDO is wrapped and do not create base USDO supply, so its mint authority is inherited from USDO (usdo-openeden). Wrapper upgrade and admin roles are held by a single issuer EOA.

controls.label: OpenEden cUSDO wrapper token
controls.capDescription: cUSDO shares are minted/burned by the OpenEden ERC-4626-style wrapper against USDO wrap/unwrap; this share accounting cannot create or destroy base USDO supply.

controls.label: Inherited USDO (OpenEden) MINTER_ROLE mint path
controls.evidence: Underlying USDO supply is created via AccessControl MINTER_ROLE held by an EOA default-admin, the USDOExpressV2 mint/redeem contract, and a CCIP burn/mint token pool (permissioned-minter, concentrated-admin); cUSDO holds USDO and inherits that base mint authority.

review.evidence: cUSDO (variantOf usdo-openeden, variantKind savings-passthrough) is a non-rebasing wrapper. At Ethereum block 25295216: asset()=USDO confirmed; proxy admin slot=0x0 (UUPS self-administered); UPGRADER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE both held by EOA 0x5eaff7af80488033bc845709806d5fae5291eb88, confirmed via hasRole reads and RoleGranted log scan (grants at blocks 21012409 and 21012420). Concentrated EOA admin consistent with OpenEden issuer-controlled model.
